title: 第十三章 乌溪兄弟
slug: 七爷全本免费-七爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
年纪轻轻的一个人，没事老喜欢弄点丹药什么的，身后常年跟着个骨瘦如柴的老道士，老道士一双三白眼，下巴尖得锥子似的，两颊干瘪，叫人一眼见了就觉得不像好人。
赫连琪长得绝不能说不好，乍看上去还隐隐有种让人惊艳的感觉，可是就是这个看上去翩翩风度的青年，却是比赫连钊更要命的对手。
说到底，赫连钊虽然耍狠，可他是个粗人。
景七突然拉住乌溪，却把乌溪吓了一跳，他素来不容人近身，除了不愿意和人打交道之外，也是因为身上养着毒物——比如手腕上就缠了一条剧毒的竹叶青。
景七通知都不通知一声就拽了他的袖子，乌溪明显感觉到腕子上的小蛇随着他的动作轻轻颤动了一下，竟探出头来，被他宽大的袖子遮着，猩红的信子吐出来，在景七的手指头上一点一点的。
虽然蛇毒有解，可乌溪看着一边南宁王这小身板，不知道他要是万一被咬上一口，撑不撑得到解药来；就是不咬，乌溪从上回那直接翻白眼晕过去的翰林的反应也知道，中原人是怕这种小毒物的，再把他吓个好歹的……
可是手指是多敏感的地方，乌溪还没来得及把冒出头来的竹叶青塞回去，景七就感觉到有东西在舔他的手，一低头，正好和乌溪袖子里那条碧绿的小蛇看了个对眼，乌溪心跳停顿了一下。
却不料，景七只是淡淡地扫了那小蛇一眼，好像那玩意儿只是个普通的镯子似的，没啥反应，也没撒手，略微把乌溪往后拽了半步，不叫他直面赫连琪，然后拿眼示意赫连翊。
更奇的是，乌溪袖子里的小蛇盯着这个人的手，拿信子触碰几下，过了一会也觉得没趣，莫名其妙地又缩了回去，老老实实地盘在乌溪的手腕上。
乌溪松了口气。
虽说赫连琪是兄，赫连翊是弟，但赫连翊乃是东宫太子，算起来是“君”，赫连琪和赫连钊见了，都是要行礼的。
可眼下三兄弟是怎么回事，大家心里都有数，赫连钊压根没过来打招呼，远远地见了，倨傲地点个头，竟就这么过去了，赫连琪也极敷衍地做了个礼，似笑非笑地招呼道：“太子殿下。”
赫连翊垂下眼笑了笑，脸上看不出有丝毫的勉强，仍是彬彬有礼道：“二皇兄。”
忍人所不能忍者，方能成其大业。
景七拉住乌溪，有不叫他说话的意思，自己也退在一边，随着赫连翊草草见了个礼。
赫连琪的目光在他身上停留了片刻，皮笑肉不笑地说道：“有日子没见，北渊真是越发俊了。”
这话说得就更不对了，这口气，明显该是长辈对小辈、上对下说的。
赫连沛是长辈又是君，说得，太子赫连翊年纪大着几岁，在南宁王面前也算君，仗着交情好，也勉强说得。
可这赫连琪不过占着个皇子的名号，尚未封王，若不是龙子皇孙，单论品级还不及景七这正牌圣祖爷亲封的亲王。赫连琪却用这口气说出来，似乎觉得自己高人一等似的。
要是别人，估计不翻脸也得气得滞一下，所幸景七装孙子的本事不比赫连翊低，也只是轻轻一哂掩过：“二殿下过誉。”

赫连琪的目光钩子似的在他身上划过，最后停在了乌溪身上，他那眼睛极好看，狭长上挑，说不出的风流妩媚，可乌溪却觉得，这二皇子的目光比见血封侯的毒蛇还要恶毒上几分，和他对视的时候，叫人觉得背后浮起一层阴阴的凉气。
赫连琪对他笑道：“哟，我道是谁，这不是巫童么？见尊驾一回，可真是不容易。太子今儿面子真不小。”
乌溪手置于胸前，冷冷淡淡地说道：“二殿下。”
赫连琪嗤笑一声，伸出白皙的手指整理着自己的袖子，指指一边干柴一样的老道人，故意拖长了声音，阴阳怪气地说道：“久闻巫童神通广大，精通南疆巫蛊之术，这位李道兄一直求着我引荐一番，只是……看来我赫连琪面子不够大，拜帖上了几次，巫童可都闭门谢客，莫不是嫌我高攀了？”
这就是找茬加试探了，乌溪愣了一下，听得出赫连琪话里的敌意，他下意识地偏头看了一眼景七后说道：“南疆巫术和你们中原的道术是不一样的，我觉得没有什么……”
景七轻轻地在他手背上拍了一下打断他，拢起袖子，对赫连琪说道：“您瞧这误会来的，乌溪那里的情况，二殿下恐怕还不清楚吧？他家里养的那些个小动物，把来教学问的何先生给吓病了，倒现在没有先生敢上门，现在恐怕字都认不大全，哪就看得懂二殿下送来的文绉绉的拜帖？”

content_en:
He is a young man who always likes to get some elixirs when he has nothing to do. He is always followed by a scrawny old Taoist priest. The old Taoist priest has a pair of three-white eyes, a chin as sharp as an awl, and shriveled cheeks. At first sight, he does not look like a good person.
He Lianqi's appearance cannot be said to be bad. At first glance, he looks faintly stunning. However, this young man who looks elegant and graceful is actually a more deadly opponent than He Lianzhao.
After all, although He Lianzhao was ruthless, he was a rough man.
Jing Qi suddenly grabbed Wu Xi, but Wu Xi was startled. He had never allowed others to get close to him, not only because he was unwilling to deal with people, but also because he had poisons on his body - for example, there was a highly poisonous bamboo leaf wrapped around his wrist.
Jing Qi tugged on his sleeve without giving any notice. Wu Xi clearly felt the little snake on his wrist tremble slightly with his movements, and actually poked his head out, which was covered by his wide sleeves. The scarlet letter spat out, bit by bit on Jing Qi's fingers.
Although the snake venom has been cured, Wu Xi looked at the small body of King Nanning and wondered if he would be able to survive and get the antidote if he was bitten. Even if he didn't bite, Wu Xi also knew from the reaction of Han Lin who rolled his eyes and fainted last time that the people of the Central Plains were afraid of this little poison, so he would be better off scaring him...
But the fingers are so sensitive. Before Wu Xi could stuff the sprouted bamboo leaves back, Jing Qi felt something licking his hand. When he lowered his head, he happened to look into the eyes of the small green snake in Wu Xi's sleeve. Wu Xi's heartbeat paused.
Unexpectedly, Jing Qi just glanced at the little snake indifferently, as if it was just an ordinary bracelet. He didn't react and didn't let go. He slightly pulled Wu Xi back half a step to prevent him from facing He Lianqi, and then pointed his eyes at He Lian Yi.
What's even more surprising is that the little snake in Wu Xi's sleeve stared at the man's hand and touched it with the letter a few times. After a while, it felt bored, and inexplicably retracted it again, and coiled itself around Wu Xi's wrist.
Wu Xi breathed a sigh of relief.
Although He Lianqi is the elder brother and He Lianyi is the younger brother, He Lianyi is the prince of the East Palace and is considered the "jun". He Lianqi and He Lianzhao both have to bow when they meet.
But now everyone knew what was going on with the three brothers. He Lianzhao didn't come over to say hello at all. He saw them from a distance, nodded arrogantly, and then passed by. He Lianqi also made a perfunctory salute, and greeted with a half-smile: "His Royal Highness the Crown Prince."
He Lianyi lowered his eyes and smiled. There was no trace of reluctance on his face, and he still said politely: "Brother Second Emperor."
Only by enduring what others cannot tolerate can one accomplish great things.
Jing Qi held Wu Xi back, not wanting him to speak, so he stepped aside and followed He Lianyi in a cursory greeting.
Helianqi's eyes stayed on him for a moment, and she said with a smile: "It's been a while since we last met, Beiyuan is really getting more and more handsome."
This is even more wrong. This tone should obviously be spoken by elders to juniors, superiors to subordinates.
He Lianpei is both the elder and the king, so to speak. Prince Helianyi is a few years older, so he is still considered the king in front of King Nanning. He can barely make it so because of their good friendship.
But this Helianqi only held the title of prince and had not yet been crowned king. If he were not the grandson of Longzi, his rank alone would not be as high as that of Jing Qi, the prince who was personally crowned by the real Saint Ancestor. But Helianqi said it in this tone, as if she felt superior to others.
If it were anyone else, he would probably be angry for a while even if he didn't fall out. Fortunately, Jing Qi's ability to pretend to be a grandson is not inferior to that of He Lianyi, so he just said lightly: "Your Highness, you are too generous."
Helianqi's eyes traced across him like hooks, and finally stopped on Wu Xi. His eyes were extremely beautiful, narrow and upward, and indescribably romantic and charming. But Wu Xi felt that the second prince's eyes were a bit more vicious than the poisonous snake that saw the blood feudal prince, and heWhen they look at each other, one feels a layer of coldness rising behind their backs.
Helianqi smiled at him and said, "Hey, who am I? Isn't this a witch boy? It's not easy to meet your master once. The prince is really proud of himself today."
Wu Xi put his hand on his chest and said coldly, "Your Highness."
He Lianqi sneered, stretched out her white fingers to straighten her sleeves, pointed at the old Taoist on the side who looked like dry wood, deliberately prolonged her voice, and said in a weird voice: "I have heard for a long time that the witch boy has great supernatural powers and is proficient in the witchcraft of southern Xinjiang. This Taoist Brother Li has been begging me to recommend him, but...it seems that I, Helianqi, don't have enough dignity. After several invitations, the witch boy thanked me behind closed doors. Could it be that I think I am too high-spirited?"
This is just to find trouble and test. Wu Xi was stunned for a moment, hearing the hostility in Helianqi's words. He subconsciously turned his head and glanced at Jing Qihou and said: "The witchcraft of southern Xinjiang is different from the Taoist magic of your Central Plains. I don't think there is anything..."
Jing Qi gently patted the back of his hand to interrupt him, rolled up his sleeves, and said to He Lianqi: "Look at this misunderstanding. I'm afraid the Second Highness is not clear about the situation in Wuxi, right? The little animals he keeps in his house scare Mr. He who comes to teach. But now no gentleman dares to come to the door. I'm afraid he can't read all the words now. How can he understand the elegant greetings sent by His Highness the Second Highness?"
